# Crates

This page is generated from `crates/*/Cargo.toml` and the package
headers in `catalogue/`, so it reports what the workspace contains rather
than what a hand-written table remembers. Regenerate it with
`node scripts/docs-matrix.js`; `node scripts/docs-check.js` fails when it
is stale.

## Provider modules

Provider clients are not crates: they are feature-flagged modules of
`wirekit` (CON-104). The [provider matrix](provider-matrix.md) reports which
of them the source actually contains.
